mentions.name: Rudy
mentions.description: A tool that publishes and optimizes Google Ads campaigns on autopilot. It supports launching campaigns globally in any location or language and provides qualitative recommendations for improving campaigns, such as recommending that typos found in search terms be added as keywords to maximize conversions.
